title: Leap years
hints: Test the rules from most specific to least specific: 400 first, then 100, then 4. If you test 4 first, 1900 wrongly counts as a leap year.
Each rule is one branch: `if year%400 == 0 { return true } else if year%100 == 0 { return false } else if ...`. Finish with `return false` after the chain.
`DaysInYear` is just `if IsLeap(year) { return 366 }` followed by `return 365`.
